issue.title: Euler Angles Wrong?
issue.body:
Hi there,

I am subscribing to euler angle information such as:

    telemetry->subscribe_attitude_euler( [&](Telemetry::EulerAngle euler) {
                setTimestamp(stateMachine->data.uavPose_.timestamp);                       
                stateMachine->data.uavPose_.roll = euler.roll_deg;
                stateMachine->data.uavPose_.pitch = euler.pitch_deg;
                stateMachine->data.uavPose_.yaw = euler.yaw_deg;
                std::cout << "Euler: (" << euler.roll_deg << ", " << euler.pitch_deg << ", " << euler.yaw_deg << ")" << std::endl;
     }); 

It seems every 6th return is a vastly different result from most:

Euler: (-0.098097, 0.0927901, -0.586002)
Euler: (-0.0981, 0.0927703, -0.585981)
Euler: (-0.0980991, 0.0927632, -0.585978)
Euler: (-0.0981108, 0.0927819, -0.585949)
Euler: (-0.0981177, 0.0927954, -0.585942)
**Euler: (114.939, 41.1869, -27.6619)**
Euler: (-0.0981175, 0.0927945, -0.585928)
Euler: (-0.0981172, 0.0927943, -0.585894)
Euler: (-0.0981132, 0.092764, -0.585896)
Euler: (-0.0981357, 0.0927864, -0.585868)
Euler: (-0.0981253, 0.0927955, -0.585837)
**Euler: (114.94, 41.1802, -27.6554)**
Euler: (-0.0981328, 0.0928163, -0.585833)
Euler: (-0.0981107, 0.0928, -0.585827)
Euler: (-0.0980776, 0.0927828, -0.585837)
Euler: (-0.0981029, 0.092776, -0.585825)
Euler: (-0.0981031, 0.0927992, -0.585849)
**Euler: (114.94, 41.1809, -27.6564)**

Do you have any idea what the reason for this is?
I am connected via serial at rate 57600. Callback is at 10Hz.

Thanks.

Hi @julianoes,
I am on:
v0.28.0 / 6d01d43e develop
Thanks
Sorry, I want to be sure. Can you post the full output of the program that you run?
No, sorry, I meant the full log output.

> I am on:
v0.28.0 / 6d01d43 develop
Thanks

It has been fixed since v0.29.0, please update. I'm closing this, re-open if you find it again.
